stem: Kabir melts a piece of chocolate, then cools it until it is solid again. He also burns a strip of paper until only ash remains.

statements.text: Melting the chocolate is reversible because the solid chocolate can be brought back on cooling.
Burning the paper is reversible because the ash can be turned back into the original strip.
Burning the paper is not reversible because the original paper strip cannot be brought back.

teacher.key_rationale: A change is reversible when the original substance can be brought back. Solid chocolate returns on cooling; ash cannot become the original paper strip.
